lines.text: The LORD says to raise your voice like a ram's horn and declare to Jacob's house their sins.
On the day of their fast, the people do as they please and oppress all their workers.
The fast God chose is to set the oppressed free, share your bread with the hungry, and clothe the naked.
If they remove the yoke, finger-pointing and malicious talk and feed the hungry, their night will be like twilight.
You will rebuild the ancient ruins and be called Keeper of the Gate, if you honor the Sabbath.
